index_title: Actual hereditary hidden SAP, representative splitting and complete-orbital readouts
scope: Private B055: all NINE source13 results and TWO equations; ten definitions, 68 human proof claims and eight tasks. Joint exact quotient lifting plus actual equivariant unary enrichment proves hidden homogeneity before hereditary SAP. Completed canonical-language homomorphisms reflect all data; anchored old fine pair types allow real collision splitting with fixed actual quotient vertices. Irreducible OLD source defects remain bounded without filling reducible ancestor pairs. Complete output orbital pullbacks have one positive old STRONG cylinder under original SAP and full terminality WITHOUT CCO; true real identity is the unique possible empty-diversity exception. Binary core is unconditional under its standing source inputs; higher-support clauses retain separate canonical tuple-completion/frozen-factor interfaces.
scope_explanation: statement and proof. Actual original group and full hidden group are kept distinct. Completion, homogeneity and SAP refer to the ACTUAL MI-only interpreted signature, including orphan-only finite closed bases. Arbitrary partial unary structures are not silently completed.

assumptions.name: Actual countable homogeneous finite complete binary old source
assumptions.statement: M is countable homogeneous in a finite complete binary relational language with finitely many nonempty transitive named real sorts, symmetric same-sort fine orbitals and paired cross-sort converses. Distinct old pairs carry exactly one diversity atom; true real equality remains logical equality. Every old invariant pair relation is a finite union of named actual Aut(M)-orbitals.

assumptions.name: Original visible SAP
assumptions.statement: The actual old finite age has strong amalgamation over every finite COMPLETE induced old base, including empty base. It can duplicate an old point outside that base while preserving the complete finite old factor, and gives infinite nonzero equivalence classes. No hidden SAP is assumed.

assumptions.name: Original semantic homomorphic CCO
assumptions.statement: Every finite old typed atomic partial graph whose specified simple cycles have old homomorphisms has ONE old homomorphism. Together with A01 this discharges the original FULL RAW exact-ball calculus and joint quotient lifting. This premise is confined to the hidden homogeneity/SAP branch; positivity and local readout branches do not use it.

assumptions.name: FULL terminal infinite relative indices
assumptions.statement: For EACH original real sort, every strict interval of actual Aut(M)-invariant equivalences has INFINITE relative index. The standing infinite FULL-cover hypothesis implies this in the finite lattice. In particular no relative-index-two interval exists; this is checked on the FULL invariant lattice rather than the represented MI sublattice. CCO-free positive pullback uses this original premise.

assumptions.name: Actual completed MI-only hidden language
assumptions.statement: H is the actual interpretation consisting of original reals and proper nonidentity represented MI quotient sorts Id<J<Top, their projections, upward maps and equivariant quotient bijections/inverses. ALL actual original-Aut binary orbitals between these sorts are named, with same-sort off-diagonal cylinders and logical equality separately; canonical old pair types are retained. Completed finite hidden members are induced and unary-closed in H. No nullary vertex generators. The added functions are ACTUAL equivariant maps, not arbitrary formal unary interpretations.

assumptions.name: Arbitrary actual equivariant quotient maps for orbital branch
assumptions.statement: Independently tau:M_a->Q and sigma:M_b->R are surjective Aut(M)-equivariant maps to transitive actual quotient G-sets; kernels J,K are actual original invariant equivalences, possibly Id or Top. Theta is ONE nonempty COMPLETE output G-orbital. This needs no MI condition or hidden homogeneity; A01 identifies old diversity orbitals with fine atoms.

assumptions.name: Closed partial OLD source and homomorphism-embedding convention
assumptions.statement: C is a finite unary-functionally closed PARTIAL hidden source. A homomorphism-embedding is an induced embedding on EVERY irreducible closed source subobject; irreducible means not a free amalgam of two proper closed subobjects. For a bounded k-generated support, singleton closures have size<=m_typ (supplied for unary-admissible sources). A completion target is an ACTUAL completed hidden member. No general completion of C is assumed.

assumptions.name: SEPARATE optional finite-arity frozen-factor interface
assumptions.statement: For conditional higher-support clauses ONLY, the old finite language has a finite canonical definitional completion naming every compatible real tuple type up to the maximum arity (including equality/sort patterns), and the supplied SAP/frozen-factor interface preserves complete induced old higher-support factors during clones/completion. The binary anchor lemma controls no arity>=3 tuple by itself. Binary hidden homogeneity/SAP below is not automatically extended to this separate setting.

imports.name: thm:typed-joint-exact-lifting
imports.statement: For countable homogeneous complete typed binary old source with FULL exact-ball calculus, finitely chosen FULL exact original equivalences INCLUDING real Id, and ALL actual original-Aut pair orbitals on their quotient sorts, every finite joint binary partial isomorphism lifts to ONE original automorphism. This supplies no SAP/coherent section.

imports.name: cor:typed-joint-exact-equivariant-unary
imports.statement: Adding finitely many ACTUAL equivariant unary maps on those same exact sorts preserves homogeneity for finite induced FUNCTIONALLY CLOSED partial isomorphisms, using the same original lift. Applies to the actual projection/upward/transition functions.

imports.name: lem:typed-all-invariant-equivalences-raw-word
imports.statement: Under original same-sort symmetry and FULL no-index-two, every invariant equivalence has one RAW atomic word, Id by the empty word and nonidentity by a positive word after deleting Id letters. This representation branch needs no CCO/SAP/distributivity.

imports.name: lem:typed-unary-closure-bound
imports.statement: Actual completed singleton closures have a uniform finite bound m_typ; unary-only closure is their union and no nullary generators give cl(empty)=empty. Arbitrary malformed partial sources are excluded.

imports.name: lem:typed-hereditary-hidden-orbits
imports.statement: For EVERY finite actual closed hidden base A, even orphan-only, every u outside A has infinite orbit under the ORIGINAL Aut(M/A), and hence under full hidden stabilisers. Uses real-base orbits plus freshframes, not hidden homogeneity or SAP.

imports.name: lem:unary-homogeneous-sap-criterion
imports.statement: For a countable homogeneous unary-functional structure with finite closures, infinite FULL-Aut orbits outside every finite closed base imply strong amalgamation of its ENTIRE hereditary unary-closed age. Homogeneity must be supplied separately.

imports.name: lem:typed-cylinder-realisation
imports.statement: Actual mixed real/quotient and quotient/quotient positions have representative-independent semantic spectra, with real Id exteriors omitted; nonempty spectra are disjoint-or-equal and partition compatible distinct hidden vertex pairs. Same-hidden-sort cylinders omit their hidden diagonal.

imports.name: lem:typed-coordinate-normal-form
imports.statement: Every real-source term is real identity with Id kernel or theta after a represented nonzero proper MI projection, with theta an actual equivariant quotient bijection/identity. Exact kernel biconditional and stabiliser equality are literal.

imports.name: lem:rh-sap-invariant-monolith
imports.statement: Original SAP makes every class of a nonidentity original invariant equivalence infinite, by repeated strong copies of a nontrivial pair over one anchor; off-base real stabiliser orbits are infinite.

imports.name: lem:foundational-orbital-pullback
imports.statement: For actual equivariant surjections, full pullback of ONE output orbital is J;O;K for ANY root orbital witness O; after diversity restriction the nonempty parts partition root diversity/orbitals. Empty diversity occurs iff same root sort, both kernels Id, and the unique same-real-point graph. This group-action theorem requires no SAP, CCO or homogeneity.

imports.name: lem:typed-raw-strong-saturation
imports.statement: Off-diagonal J;t;K equals the STRONG full cylinder, with nonzero exterior palettes and true Id exteriors omitted. Its pinned original binary path support also converts one whole RAW atomic word into its STRONG diversity profile without assuming a STRONG associativity theorem.
imports.provider_support_usage: Use strict proved ancestor transition_closure C01 ONLY for pinned original binary atomic-path injectivisation: freeze the actual exterior complete fine pair, split all formal walk positions by old relational SAP and align the pair. No Set-Pasch or exact-domain premise is introduced.

imports.name: lem:no-real-algebraic-transition
imports.statement: Visible old SAP prevents a nonidentity proper coordinate from transporting to real equality; the actual transition-enriched signature therefore has no equality-coordinate orphan and no quotient-to-real transition.

definitions.name: Actual unary-closed hereditary envelope
definitions.statement: Age_cl(H) consists of all finite induced functionally closed actual substructures, including those with only orphan quotient vertices. Full point-generated objects are only a subcategory.

definitions.name: Complete hidden pair-orbital language
definitions.statement: Every compatible distinct pair has exactly one complete typed binary orbital; same-sort logical equality is separate. An actual equivariant transition graph can itself be one orbital between two named quotient sorts.

definitions.name: Anchored fine-pair readout
definitions.statement: A finite complete old frame B excludes p and contains a real representative a_q of every retained hidden q, including all represented proper coordinate values of p. Matching every fine pair pz,pprime z pins their actual quotient classes and mixed cylinders.

definitions.name: Old real collision fibre
definitions.statement: For h:C->H and actual old p, the fibre consists of formal old REAL positions mapped to p. The SAP base excludes p and contains every OTHER DISTINCT actual old image, all anchors and previous clones. Formal positions still mapping p are not distinct base points.

definitions.name: Irreducible OLD source support
definitions.statement: D=cl_C(B) for <=k actual old source vertices, with induced PARTIAL language. Irreducibility is tested on this entire closed D, not on a nonclosed two-element set or on a relation among arbitrary descendants.

definitions.name: Actual kernel pullback
definitions.statement: For equivariant surjections tau,sigma and ONE output orbital Theta, P_Theta={(x,y):Theta(tau(x),sigma(y))}; J=ker tau,K=ker sigma. Take full RAW saturation first, then remove equal OLD real endpoints.

definitions.name: True real-identity exception
definitions.statement: The graph of x -> (tau(x),sigma(x)) has empty old diversity pullback exactly when the two source carriers are the SAME original sort and BOTH kernels are actual real Id. Outputs can be different sorts.

definitions.name: Positive STRONG cylinder
definitions.statement: For a distinct old witness fine atom t, Cyl_JK(t)=(J;t;K) off the old real diagonal. Nonzero J,K have positive old RAW word presentations; omit genuine Id exteriors and retain the middle diversity atom.

definitions.name: Complete named term comparison
definitions.statement: Theta is one complete semantic-cylinder orbital, one equivariant quotient-transition graph orbital, or the equality diagonal on one transitive hidden output sort. Each is verified to be ONE original-group orbital before the positive pullback theorem is applied.

definitions.name: Reducible ancestor-pair diagnostic
definitions.statement: In an infinite equivalence source, real roots x,y with quotient values u,v and only the displayed off-diagonal relation u-v give a reducible cl{x,y}: free-amalgamate {x,u,v} and {y,u,v} over {u,v}. No old x-y colour is imposed.

claims.name: Every chosen hidden kernel is a FULL exact original equivalence
claims.statement: A04 excludes all original index-two intervals. I03 therefore gives full RAW exactness for every chosen MI quotient kernel, and real Id is its genuine empty-word exact equivalence. No distributivity is needed for this representation step.

claims.name: The actual binary hidden reduct meets the joint-lifting signature
claims.statement: By A05 the finite chosen quotient list includes every real Id coordinate, and names ALL actual original-Aut pair orbitals across those sorts, not merely selected cylinders. C01 supplies FULL exactness. Countability/homogeneity and original exact-ball source assumptions are A01/A03.

claims.name: One original lift extends every finite binary hidden partial isomorphism
claims.statement: I01 applied to C02 gives one actual g in Aut(M) extending the entire finite displayed binary map across ALL real/quotient sorts simultaneously. Quotient representatives are used only inside its proof and are not added as unconstrained data to this map.

claims.name: Actual equivariant unary enrichment gives hidden homogeneity
claims.statement: All projections/upward/transition maps in A05 are finitely many actual equivariant unary functions on the same exact sorts. I02/C03 extends any isomorphism of finite induced closed hidden subobjects by the SAME original g; equivariance makes g preserve all functions globally. Thus actual H is homogeneous, including orphan-only domains.

claims.name: Finite generated closures and countability are explicit
claims.statement: I04 supplies finite singleton closures, so finite T has closure size<=m_typ|T| by unary union. Empty T has empty closure. Quotient sorts of countable old real sorts and finitely many named sorts make H countable.

claims.name: Original closed-base orbit infinitude survives in the full hidden group
claims.statement: I05 supplies infinite Aut(M/A)-orbits outside every finite actual closed A. Original automorphisms act as hidden automorphisms by actual equivariance/interpretation, so these orbits are contained in full Aut(H/A)-orbits, which are infinite. Equality of the groups is not required.

claims.name: Every premise of the hereditary unary SAP criterion is discharged
claims.statement: C04 actual homogeneity, C05 countability/finite closures and C06 full hidden orbit infinitude match I06 on the ENTIRE hereditary closed age, not only real-point-generated objects. No hidden SAP was used to establish any of these inputs.

claims.name: The resulting strong amalgam separates arbitrary hidden extensions
claims.statement: I06/C07 yields, for every finite actual closed span B1<-A->B2, a finite unary-closed induced hidden target with exact intersection A. Its proof aligns the closed base by C04 and uses one full-hidden stabiliser avoidance move. Orphan-only and empty A are included.

claims.name: Typed hereditary hidden SAP source export
claims.statement: C08 proves thm:typed-hidden-sap for the actual binary MI-only transition-enriched envelope. The old complete exact-lifting, original real-base orbit and freshframe inputs remain retained transitively. No coherent/functorial choice of lifts or new Ramsey theorem is concluded.

claims.name: Sort predicates already separate differently typed vertices
claims.statement: A homomorphism between completed hidden members preserves their mutually disjoint named sort predicates. Points in different real or quotient sorts therefore cannot be identified. This uses actual sort partition, not hidden SAP.

claims.name: Complete real pair colours force injection within every real sort
claims.statement: Two distinct same-real-sort vertices carry one irreflexive fine pair atom, whose image cannot be diagonal. For any distinct real pair, the unique target pair atom is the preserved source atom, so its full binary old type is reflected as well.

claims.name: Off-diagonal quotient cylinders force injection within coordinate sorts
claims.statement: Two distinct vertices of one proper quotient sort carry exactly one off-diagonal cylinder by I07/A05. It is irreflexive on that output sort, so their images are distinct. Different coordinate sorts were already separated by C10.

claims.name: Complete hidden pair partitions reflect every compatible binary relation
claims.statement: Any mixed real/quotient or quotient/quotient pair has its one complete output orbital by I07. Its image satisfies that same relation; the target partition permits no different orbital. Together with injectivity this reflects the source relation and the absence of every other named pair relation.

claims.name: Total typed unary functions reflect all graph identities
claims.statement: Completed members are induced and unary-closed, and each function domain is fixed by its source sort. A homomorphism preserves every value; injectivity means f(x)=y iff the corresponding target value equals the image of y. There is no additional partial-domain choice to reflect.

claims.name: The optional canonical tuple-type completion reflects higher data
claims.statement: Under SEPARATE A08, every compatible old real tuple up to maximum arity has one complete canonical type predicate, including its sort/equality pattern and all positive/negative old relation data. Preservation plus uniqueness reflects that tuple type and hence every old higher-support relation. The binary pair argument alone supplies none of this.

claims.name: Completed hidden homomorphisms are embeddings
claims.statement: C10-C14 give the binary source result WITHOUT A08; C15 separately supplies the finite-arity addendum ONLY when A08 is supplied. The map is injective, preserves and reflects all named relations and functions, so it is an induced embedding. This rigidity does not assert automorphism triviality.

claims.name: An anchor in each retained coordinate class pins that class
claims.statement: For a retained J-coordinate of p, take its anchor a_q in J[p], with a_q!=p because p is excluded from the frame. Matching fine colours pprime-a_q and p-a_q implies pprime J a_q by invariance of J, hence [pprime]_J=[p]_J.

claims.name: All named coordinate terms then have exactly the same values
claims.statement: I08 expresses each real-source nonidentity term as a named function of an original represented MI coordinate. C17 pins those coordinates; applying fixed actual upward maps and quotient transitions gives the same outputs for p,pprime, even through other original sorts. Real identity itself is not asserted equal.

claims.name: Each real-to-retained-coordinate cylinder has the same readout
claims.statement: For retained q in b/K, use its chosen a_q in the frame. I07 determines the mixed cylinder of (p,q) by col(p,a_q), K and the omitted real-Id exterior. The identical fine typed pair for pprime gives the SAME cylinder of (pprime,q). This also covers mixed original real sorts.

claims.name: Coordinate-to-coordinate data remain literal actual data
claims.statement: Every relevant proper coordinate of pprime equals the corresponding coordinate of p by C17. Therefore its relations to retained old quotient vertices, and all relations between old quotient vertices, are unchanged as literal actual pairs. No new cross relations or quotient representatives are chosen.

claims.name: Anchored readout is binary and does not commute mixed products
claims.statement: C17-C20 use only original fine typed pair orbitals and actual represented classes/functions. No mixed-sort relational product is commuted. Arity>=3 original tuples are outside these conclusions and require A08 when used later.

claims.name: Anchored fine clone-reading source export
claims.statement: C17-C21 prove the stated coordinate/term/cylinder conclusions and ACR equation under their actual complete-frame hypothesis, without original CCO, hidden homogeneity or hidden SAP.

claims.name: Each nonzero represented quotient fibre contains arbitrarily many anchors
claims.statement: I09 under original SAP makes every nonidentity invariant class infinite. For finitely many target quotient vertices/classes, choose their actual representatives successively outside all previous choices and all current old real image points, even when requested classes coincide.

claims.name: Fix ONE complete finite old anchor frame before all real clones
claims.statement: Choose C23 anchors for EVERY old proper source vertex (including orphans and named term values) and every represented coordinate of each old real image. Include all current DISTINCT real images and take the induced complete visible structure. Its anchor-only part excludes every real image. Include the original finite target A in the current complete old structure as well, so it is retained literally throughout the ambient old construction.

claims.name: A direct source relation closes to an irreducible joined support
claims.statement: If a displayed old binary tuple contains distinct real source u,v, every free decomposition must place that whole tuple in one closed factor; unary closure then puts ALL cl_C{u,v} in that factor. Thus this closed support is irreducible. A literal two-point set need not itself be closed.

claims.name: No displayed real fine atom lies inside a collision fibre
claims.statement: If h(u)=h(v)=p for distinct old real u,v carrying a direct fine atom, C25 gives an irreducible source support, on which h is an induced embedding by A07. It cannot identify u,v. Hence such a fine source relation is absent; no missing colour between those roots needs preserving.

claims.name: The correct complete SAP base omits the actual collided point
claims.statement: For one collision fibre at p take the current COMPLETE old visible structure and remove ONLY its actual point p from the SAP base. Keep every anchor, all OTHER DISTINCT current real images and all prior clones. Other formal source positions still mapped to p do not create extra base points.

claims.name: One old SAP duplication supplies a distinct fine-type clone
claims.statement: Strongly amalgamate two copies of that complete old structure over C27 base. Embed/align the original factor over itself by old homogeneity. Its second copy pprime differs from p and every base point, with the same fine pair type to every base point, while the original target A remains contained in the ambient limit.

claims.name: Anchors preserve ALL existing hidden quotient values during cloning
claims.statement: Assign pprime to one source real position and keep p for other positions in its fibre. C22 and the fixed anchors give the same prescribed quotient coordinates, all named proper term values, and every mixed cylinder reading against old retained proper vertices. No unforced quotient output is independently reassigned.

claims.name: Every displayed binary source datum remains a homomorphism datum
claims.statement: A fine real pair at the moved root has other endpoint outside its collision fibre by C26, hence in the fixed base and its colour preserved by C28. Mixed/quotient pairs and function graphs are preserved by C29; old quotient vertices stay fixed. Irreducible source factor maps also retain their induced types, since h was injective there and all its other real images are fixed.

claims.name: Finite collision descent terminates with pairwise distinct old real images
claims.statement: Repeat C27-C30 keeping previous clones in the next fixed complete base. Each step increases the number of distinct images of old real source positions by one and leaves all their old proper term values fixed. The number of real source positions is finite, so all old real collisions are removed.

claims.name: Every old proper coordinate gets a distinct actual representative
claims.statement: Use its C23 prechosen anchor; they are pairwise distinct and disjoint from original real images. Each later clone was chosen outside the whole fixed anchor frame, so these representatives are also disjoint from all final real images. They still represent the SAME actual old target classes, including coincident images of different proper source vertices.

claims.name: Choose one finite visible extension and retain optional support gate
claims.statement: Take the induced old structure A_prime on original A, all anchors and all clones; it is finite in the actual age. All required data persist by C30-C32. Exact-domain guarded labels are not hidden-language relations and must retain/reinstall their own private paths/anchors separately. For arity>=3 use only the separately assumed complete-factor interface A08.

claims.name: Typed representative splitting source export
claims.statement: C23-C33 gives distinct old real images and distinct designated real representatives for all old proper coordinate positions after finite visible extension, preserving specified binary hidden relations/functions. Existing quotient vertices are not split; optional higher-support factors remain conditional on A08. No real-equality orphan occurs in A05, as justified by I12.

claims.name: A homomorphism-embedding embeds every ACTUALLY irreducible closed support
claims.statement: For D=cl_C(B) irreducible in the partial old hidden language, any completion map restricts to an induced embedding on D by the definition in A07. This does not apply to an arbitrary reducible closure of two root ancestors.

claims.name: The image support is functionally closed and a completed induced member
claims.statement: Function preservation and injectivity make the image of closed D closed. The completion target is actual completed and its induced closed finite subobject is again a completed member by heredity. Thus D itself must already have that FULL completed induced pattern.

claims.name: Any missing mandatory pattern datum blocks completion
claims.statement: If every completed realization of the joining data has an extra named relation, literal equality/inequality or functional identity absent in D, no induced embedding C36 can exist. A missing relation contradicts reflection; a forced identification of distinct source vertices contradicts injectivity. Therefore C is noncompletable.

claims.name: The old defect support size is at most k times m_typ
claims.statement: Under the stated singleton bounds, unary closure of <=k generators is their union. Hence |D|<=sum_b |cl_C(b)|<=k*m_typ. No bound is asserted for arbitrary malformed total-unary partial sources without A07 singleton bounds.

claims.name: Joined OLD support defect source export
claims.statement: C35-C38 prove the complete-pattern defect criterion and its old-source size bound. Irreducibility is substantive and cannot be inferred solely from a relation among descendants in a common quotient subdiagram.

claims.name: Full pullback of one output orbital is literal root-kernel saturation
claims.statement: By I10, for one root orbital O in P_Theta, the FULL relation is P_Theta=J;O;K. This follows from moving ONE root witness pair by the same g and then changing representatives in kernel fibres. A01 identifies a distinct-root O with one actual fine atom t.

claims.name: Distinct-root output witnesses give exactly the nonempty cylinder
claims.statement: If P_Theta has a pair x!=y, choose its actual fine atom t. C40 and diversity restriction give exactly (J;t;K)^circ, the full representative cylinder of ANY such atom. Saturate before removing true real equality. Output quotient equality is allowed.

claims.name: Empty diversity forces same real sort and both kernels identity
claims.statement: I10 gives a diagonal root witness when diversity is empty, forcing a=b. If J or K had a nontrivial class, transitivity gives a distinct mate at that witness; replacing that endpoint keeps output values unchanged, contradicting empty diversity. Thus J=K=Id. No SAP or CCO is used.

claims.name: The exceptional orbital is exactly the same-original-point graph
claims.statement: With C42 both maps are bijections onto their transitive outputs. The orbit of (tau(x),sigma(x)) is exactly their common-source graph, and its pullback is true real Id by injectivity. Conversely that graph has no diversity preimage. There is at most ONE such orbital, even if output sorts differ.

claims.name: Joined distinct-real identity requirements are local defects
claims.statement: In C43 every real preimage has equal endpoints. A requirement that two DISTINCT real roots in an actually irreducible old support realize it contradicts induced injectivity; C39 gives a bounded defect when its singleton bound holds. For two terms at the SAME old root use its unary closure instead. No STRONG identity edge is inserted.

claims.name: Term-orbital diversity dichotomy source export
claims.statement: C41-C44 prove the exact nonempty-cylinder versus same-real-point identity alternatives. The underlying orbital classification needs no SAP or positivity theorem; the bounded-defect addendum has its explicit irreducible-source/singleton-bound premises.

claims.name: Arbitrary actual output kernels are original invariant equivalences
claims.statement: For A06 maps, equivariance makes J,K invariant equivalences. In A01 each is a finite union of actual named old pair orbitals, hence a full original definable equivalence. They need not be MI, proper or named hidden sorts to use the next RAW word argument.

claims.name: FULL terminality gives a RAW word for each endpoint kernel
claims.statement: A04 excludes relative-index-two intervals. I03 therefore gives an actual RAW atomic word for J and K. For nonidentity kernels its word can have Id letters deleted and remains positive; for true Id use the genuine empty word. CCO, exact-ball Helly and distributivity are not used.

claims.name: A diversity witness supplies one positive typed whole word
claims.statement: For a nonempty diversity pullback choose t as C41. Concatenate the J word, t and the K word in this typed order. The represented RAW relation is J;t;K, and the word is positive because it contains t even when one or both exteriors are true Id. No STRONG associativity is used.

claims.name: Pinned original SAP converts the FULL RAW word to its STRONG profile
claims.statement: For distinct prescribed old endpoints in J;t;K take a homomorphic witness of the entire C48 atomic word. I11 strict C01 support freezes their actual exterior fine pair, injectivises ALL formal positions of the old word by original relational SAP and aligns those endpoints. Thus its off-diagonal RAW relation equals one STRONG positive word profile. Reverse inclusion is immediate.

claims.name: Exterior saturation formula and output partition remain exact
claims.statement: I11 gives the same profile as J^circ*t*K^circ with each real-Id exterior omitted. C41 ensures it is nonempty. I10 makes different complete output orbital pullbacks disjoint and covers all old diversity atoms; its sole empty exception is C43. No hidden SAP or quotient inheritance is inferred.

claims.name: CCO-free complete-orbital positive pullback source export
claims.statement: C46-C50 proves all assertions under original homogeneous symmetric binary SAP and full no-finite-index cuts only. This branch does not import original CCO, exact-ball Helly, lattice distributivity, hidden homogeneity/SAP or an exact quotient Ramsey theorem. Arbitrary kernel quotients are used as G-sets, not added to the hidden language.

claims.name: Named real-source terms are equivariant surjections with exact kernels
claims.statement: I08/A05 gives identity or theta F_J. Every named quotient projection is onto and theta is an equivariant bijection, so its image is the whole named transitive output sort. Real identity has actual Id kernel; other kernels are nonzero represented proper MI.

claims.name: A complete semantic cylinder is ONE actual output orbital
claims.statement: For any two actual position pairs in the same complete cylinder, I07 supplies representatives with one COMMON old fine atom. Original pair homogeneity sends one representative pair to the other and therefore sends their actual quotient positions too. Hence the cylinder is one original-group orbital, not an unverified union.

claims.name: Equality and transition graphs are also single orbitals
claims.statement: Equality on one transitive output sort is its diagonal orbital. A named equivariant quotient bijection graph is one orbital because its transitive domain moves all its graph pairs under the SAME group element. These assertions use actual equivariance/transitivity, not mere function syntax.

claims.name: The distinct-real witness selects the positive cylinder alternative
claims.statement: For any allowed comparison Theta, C52-C54 verify A06. Its stipulated x0!=y0 witness excludes the empty-diversity branch. Apply C51 to get EXACTLY Cyl_JK(t0), one nonempty positive STRONG typed word profile. Constancy on every old fine atom follows from original equivariance.

claims.name: Complete named term-pair pullback source export
claims.statement: C55 proves TOP and positivity for every allowed single complete comparison. C45 handles its exact excluded same-real-point exception; quotient diagonals with distinct real representatives remain positive and are not excluded. Same-root identities are checked in one unary closure.

claims.name: Every old diversity atom belongs to one output-orbital part
claims.statement: The image of any actual old fine pair orbit under tau times sigma is ONE output orbit by equivariance and the same group action. Surjectivity of maps supplies all output pairs, while root diversity restriction removes only equal real endpoints. Thus every realized old diversity atom lies in one part.

claims.name: Distinct output orbitals have disjoint old atom parts
claims.statement: If one old fine atom belonged to two parts, its full root orbit would map into each by equivariance, so those output orbitals would overlap and hence be equal. Complete orbitals rather than arbitrary unions are essential.

claims.name: Each nonempty part is one positive full cylinder with at most one empty part
claims.statement: For a nonempty part choose a distinct-root witness atom. C51 identifies that whole part with its one saturated positive cylinder. C43 classifies every possible empty part as the unique same-real-point graph, with a=b and both kernels Id.

claims.name: Exact diversity partition source export
claims.statement: C57-C59 prove the source corollary. No union of distinct output orbitals is asserted to be one cylinder or reachable profile, and genuine real-Id exteriors are omitted from every STRONG word.

claims.name: The reducible descendant relation does not join its real ancestors
claims.statement: For D10, both {x,u,v} and {y,u,v} are proper unary-closed induced substructures and their free amalgam over {u,v} is the entire partial diagram: all displayed x-data concern u, y-data concern v, and the u-v relation lies in the base. Thus cl{x,y} is reducible despite related descendants. Choosing x,y in distinct E-classes completes it, so no old x-y type may be filled before completion.

claims.name: A hidden quotient diagonal can have nonempty real diversity preimage
claims.statement: In two original real sorts over a common infinite block index, proper same-block quotients QA,QB have an actual inverse transition. A same-block cross atom pulls back the matched quotient graph to itself. On QA times QA its true quotient diagonal pulls back to same-block DIVERSITY pA, using distinct clones in one infinite block. It is not the true real diagonal.

claims.name: Omitting an actual inverse transport can create orphan algebraicity
